name: Tailwind CSS landing page by tailwindcss.com
description: A long developer-tool landing page that pairs an airy white editorial layout with dark, editor-styled code panels as the hero visual and throughout the feature bento grid. The page builds trust with a dense sponsor logo wall, then shifts rhythm into a playful, illustrated bento of feature cards each containing a live UI demo (responsive cards, dark-mode banking widget, colour palettes, easing curves). Small monospace eyebrow labels, a giant tight-tracked grotesque headline, and pink/teal utility-class highlights in body copy carry the product's own identity into the design.
